messages:
Ravi: Need to lock customer-facing comms for the brief outage this morning. Can we confirm who sends the public status and who handles full RCAs for contract customers?
Hannah: I can draft the public status page blurb and a short customer email. Want it live tonight.
Olga: Ops: timeline confirmed 09:12-09:41 UTC. ~14k retries, ~120 5xx. No auth or data exposure.
ops-bot: Note: this is the second network-related incident in 6 weeks in eu-central. Recommend an aggregated follow-up.
Marta: Legal: for customers under contract we can share the full RCA; public page should be a redacted summary that omits internal configs and vendor blame.
supportbot: Support will prepare the affected-customer list and distribution plan once legal approves.
Ravi: Proposal: two-step comms -> 1) public status page + email summary tonight (concise, no sensitive details) 2) detailed RCA to affected contract customers after legal sign-off (next business day).
Hannah: Draft snippet: "Resolved: elevated latency and intermittent request failures in eu-central (09:12-09:41 UTC). Cause: transient upstream network instability that impacted cache priming. Impact: some requests failed or were retried; no customer data exposed. Mitigation: config rollback and cache persistence. We're scheduling a reliability review." Thoughts?
Olga: LGTM. Ops will paste exact counts into the postmortem before publish.
Marta: Legal asks we record in the postmortem the approval chain and list of customers who received full RCAs for audit.
Ravi: Action items:
- Olga (Ops): paste final timeline + metrics into postmortem (by 14:00 UTC)
- Hannah (Product): publish public status + email draft (by 20:00 UTC)
- Support: prepare affected-customer list and distribution plan (by COB)
- Marta/Legal: review detailed RCA and approve distribution (by next business day)
- Ravi: open infra follow-up ticket to analyze recurring network flaps (owner: Ravi, due in 7 days)
ops-bot: Reminder: assign follow-ups in tracker https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4237/actions
Hannah: Posting draft to #incidents-drafts for quick review. Please avoid vendor-specific language.
Ravi: Keep comms clear: impact, what we did, data exposure (explicitly none), and next steps. We'll reconvene if facts change. :thumbsup:
